dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 11, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**METS STUN CARDINALS IN THRILLER, DODGERS TAKE DOWN PIRATES**

In a back-and-forth matchup, the New York Mets edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 5-4 behind a strong outing from Brooks Raley, who earned the win. Juan Soto powered the Mets with his 14th home run of the season, a fly ball to right center field. Jared Young also had a big day, going 2-for-4 with a home run and 2 RBI. On the pitching side, Christian Scott made a significant impact, but Devin Williams earned the save with 1 scoreless inning, striking out 2.

In other news, the Detroit Tigers dominated the Minnesota Twins 11-0, with Colt Keith leading the way with a 2-hit, 3-RBI performance, including a home run. Keider Montero pitched 6.1 strong innings, giving up 0 earned runs and striking out 4. Meanwhile, the Miami Marlins took down the Arizona Diamondbacks 2-0, with Tyler Phillips tossing 5 scoreless innings and striking out 5.
